// diagnostic

E0517

`{name}` can't {action} in a deep check

What

`{name}` can't {action} in a deep check

Why

A deep check runs only where `--deep-checks` keeps it, so it may read the state around it but not change it.

Fix

Change a copy the body makes itself, or move the change out of the `#On(.Deep)` body.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0517: tests/ui/deep_check_changes_state.stderr.

Error [jet.DeepCheckChangesState]: `total` can't be assigned in a deep check
  --> tests/ui/deep_check_changes_state.jet:9:13
    |
  9 |             total += 1
    |             ^^^^^
 Why: A deep check runs only where `--deep-checks` keeps it, so it may read the state around it but not change it.
 Fix: Change a copy the body makes itself, or move the change out of the `#On(.Deep)` body.
